 Judgment

Dated this the 11th day of April, 2025 This Land Acquisition Appeal is filed by the State challenging the judgment and decree in LAR No. 867 of 2009 dated 31.10.2015 of the II Additional Sub Court,
Thiruvananthapuram.
Respondents 1 and 2 are the original claimants in the LAR.
Parties are hereinafter referred to as per their status before the reference court.

2. An extent of 0.42 Ares of land in Re-Sy.No.439/33 of Kudappanakunnu village in T h i r u v a n a n t h a p u r a m T a l u k w a s a c q u i r e d f o r t h e p u r p o s e o f w i d e n i n g o f Mannanthala-Kesavadasapuram road.
Section 4(1) notification was published on 31.01.2005 and Award was passed on 21.02.2008.
The land was taken possession of on 25.03.2007.
The Land Acquisition Officer (LAO) had fixed the land value at Rs.2,69,906/- per Are.
Dissatisfied with the compensation awarded by the LAO, the claimants had filed a reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.
The reference court refixed the land value at Rs.19,20,000/- per Are.

The State had State Of Kerala Represented By The ... vs Alexander,S/O Mathai on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155384891/
2 filed this appeal, contending that the enhancement 2025:KER:32889 awarded by the reference court, relying on its own earlier judgment in other reference matters relating to the very same acquisition and purpose is erroneous as it overlooked the fact that in the appeals preferred from the said judgments, this Court had scaled down the land value of the property.

sentences.text: 3. Heard Smt.Rekha C.Nair, learned Senior Government Pleader on behalf of the State/appellant.
Respondents 1 and 2 (Claimants 1 and 2) had expired and hence respondents 3 and 4, who are the daughters, and R5, who is the grandson of claimants 1 and 2, were impleaded in this LAA.
Though service is complete as against respondents 3, 4 and 5, there is no appearance on their behalf.

4. The learned Senior Government pleader has brought to my notice the judgment of this Court in LAA No.120 of 2014 and connected cases which concerned acquisition under the same notification dated 31.01.2005 for the very same purpose.
This Court had in the said appeals re-fixed the land value for the lands belonging to the same category as the acquired land at Rs. 9,16,000/- per Are.
A copy of the judgment dated 01.04.2019 of this 2025:KER:32889 Court in L.A.A.No.120 of 2014 is handed over to me for perusal.
I note that the purpose of the acquisition is the same and the property involved in both LAAs are situated in the same village.
5. In view of the above, the value of the land acquired from claimants 1 and 2 is re
- fixed at Rs.9,16,000/- per Are commensurate to the extent acquired.

The judgment and decree in LAR No.
867 of 2009 dated 31.10.2015 of the II Additional Sub Court, Thiruvananthapuram is modified to the said extent.
Claimants shall also be entitled to interest and statutory benefits as envisaged in law.
L.A.A. is allowed.

Sd/-
SYAM KUMAR V.M.
